summary: Frontend testing of GHG Calculation Platform v2 updates. All v2 features verified successfully with one bug fix applied.

bugs_fixed.issue: ReferenceError: filterYear is not defined - caused Emissions page crash when clicking Show Filters
bugs_fixed.fix: Changed 'filterYear' to 'filterDateRange.from || filterDateRange.to' to match actual state variable name

context_for_next_testing_agent: GHG Platform v2 features tested and verified. Bug fix applied to Emissions.js line 889 (filterYear -> filterDateRange).

mandatory_address_fields.details: All address fields show asterisks: Organization Name *, Street Address *, City *, State/Province *, Country *, PIN/ZIP Code *

dual_logo_options.details: Company Logo section with Option 1: Enter Logo URL (input field) and Option 2: Upload Logo Image (file upload button)

mandatory_references.details: References field shows asterisk (*) and placeholder text 'Links or detailed references (required)'

link_upload_remarks.details: Form includes: Add Link (name + URL), Or Upload File (drag-drop area 'Drop file here or click to upload'), Remarks / Notes textarea

attachments_remarks.details: Edit mode includes: Attachments section with Add Link + Upload File drag-drop area, Remarks / Notes field

simple_date_inputs.details: Date Range filter uses type='month' inputs (browser native month picker), NOT calendar popovers

download_report_text.details: Button text is 'Download Report' (per-facility) and 'Download Report (N facilities)' (combined), NOT 'Download Combined Report'

bug_rca.issue: Emissions page crashed with 'ReferenceError: filterYear is not defined' when Show Filters was clicked
bug_rca.root_cause: Code refactoring changed filter state from 'filterYear' to 'filterDateRange' (object with from/to properties), but line 889 still referenced the old variable name
bug_rca.fix_applied: Changed conditional from 'filterYear' to 'filterDateRange.from || filterDateRange.to' to check if date range filter is set
